releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.42 fixes the Instagram media pipeline at the source. The Cloudflare resolver now returns a trusted media-proxy URL, and Smart Life prefers that proxy so Instagram/Facebook CDN protection pages are no longer saved as fake .jpg files. Downloads now require a real image/video Content-Type before they are accepted. Existing broken Instagram Library posts can repair themselves: open the post once and Smart Life re-fetches the original public Instagram URL into the same Library item, keeping the old copy unless the replacement succeeds. New shares use the proxy path immediately.
